code.install: Clone the code with git-lfs into ComfyUI's models folder: 'git lfs install && git clone https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/HY-Motion-1.0 <ComfyUI>/models/text_to_motion/code/HY-Motion-1.0', then 'pip install torchdiffeq transformers accelerate einops pyyaml omegaconf' and restart ComfyUI. See docs/VNCCS_POSE_STUDIO_TEXT_TO_MOTION.md.

requirements.notes: Text-only: the motion cannot start from a given pose, so Pose Studio applies its movement on top of the current pose. The Qwen3-8B text encoder is most of the download.
